Home.title: Konnected
Home.lede: Short project assignments for students and startups. Konnected approves every project and matches the students.
Home.placeholder: This page is a placeholder. The dashboards come in later steps.
Home.teamEndedBody: This address is no longer on the Konnected team list. Ask the team if you need access again.

ChooseRole.title: How will you use Konnected?
ChooseRole.lede: Signed in as {email}. Pick the option that fits. Konnected checks every student profile and every company before they take part.
ChooseRole.student1: Build a profile and upload your CV
ChooseRole.student2: Apply to projects Konnected has approved
ChooseRole.student3: Deliver through Konnected, and on paid projects get paid through Konnected
ChooseRole.company2: Submit a project with a clear deliverable, paid or unpaid
ChooseRole.company3: Konnected finds the student and releases the result to you

Entry.title: Short, real projects for university students
Entry.lede: Startups send in a project, paid or unpaid. Konnected decides if it goes ahead, picks a student and handles any payment.
Entry.factReview: Konnected reviews every company and every student profile.
Entry.factPrivacy: Companies never browse students. They see only what a selected student agreed to share.
Entry.factCoordinate: Konnected coordinates the work and the payment.
Entry.tabsLabel: Sign in or create an account
Entry.teamGoogle: Konnected team members sign in with Google.
Entry.ruleBreach: Checked against known data breaches when you save
Entry.confirmFirst: We email you a link to confirm your address before your first sign-in.
Entry.linkSentBody: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. Open it on this device. It works once and expires in 15 minutes.
Entry.spamHint: Nothing in your inbox? Look in your spam folder.
Entry.verifySentBody: We sent a message to {email}. Open the link in it to confirm your address. After that you can sign in with your password.
Entry.verifySentNote: You cannot sign in with a password before you confirm your email.
Entry.sessionEndedBody: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.

AuthErrors.emailInvalid: Enter an email address, like name@example.no.
AuthErrors.breached: This password has appeared in a data breach. Choose another one.
AuthErrors.signInFailed: Email or password is not right.
AuthErrors.signInFailedHint: After 5 wrong tries sign-in is paused for 15 minutes.
AuthErrors.locked: After 5 wrong passwords, sign-in is paused for 15 minutes. You can wait, or sign in with an email link instead.
AuthErrors.unverified: We sent you a new link. Open it to confirm your address, then sign in.
AuthErrors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
AuthErrors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
AuthErrors.paused: Write to Konnected if you think this is a mistake.

MagicLink.title: Sign in to Konnected
MagicLink.lede: Press the button to finish signing in. The link works once.
MagicLink.expiredLede: Sign-in links work once, and only for 15 minutes. Ask for a new one.

Verify.title: Confirm your email
Verify.lede: Press the button to confirm this address for your Konnected account.
Verify.doneLede: You can sign in with your password now.
Verify.invalidLede: It may have been used already. Try to sign in. If your email still needs confirming, we send you a new link.

Reset.askLede: Enter the email you signed up with. If it matches an account, we send a link to set a new password.
Reset.sentLede: If an account exists for {email}, we sent a link to set a new password. The link works once and expires in about an hour.
Reset.sentNote: This message is the same for every address, so nobody can use this page to find out who has an account.
Reset.newLede: Choose a password of at least {min} characters. A phrase of several words works well, and you can paste from a password manager.
Reset.doneLede: You can sign in with your new password now. Any other devices were signed out.
Reset.invalidLede: Reset links work once, and for about an hour. Ask for a new one.

common.linkFallback: If the button does not work, copy this address into your browser:
common.footer: Konnected, konnected.no. You get this email because this address was used on the Konnected sign-in page.
common.accountFooter: Konnected, konnected.no. You get this email because you have a Konnected account.

verify.subject: Confirm your email for Konnected
verify.heading: Confirm your email
verify.body: Confirm your address to finish creating your Konnected account. After that you can sign in with your password.
verify.ignore: If you did not sign up, you can ignore this email. The account cannot be used without this step.

magicLink.subject: Your Konnected sign-in link
magicLink.heading: Sign in to Konnected
magicLink.body: Use the button to sign in to Konnected. The link works once and expires in 15 minutes.
magicLink.ignore: If you did not ask for it, you can ignore this email. Nobody can sign in without the link.

accountExists.subject: You already have a Konnected account
accountExists.heading: You already have an account
accountExists.body: Someone tried to create a new Konnected account with this address. You already have one, so nothing was changed.
accountExists.howTo: Sign in with Google, with an email sign-in link, or with your password. If you forgot your password, choose “Forgot your password?” on the sign-in page.
accountExists.ignore: If this was not you, you can ignore this email. Your account has not changed.

team.heading: Konnected team accounts sign in with Google
team.link: Someone asked for a sign-in link for this address.
team.signup: Someone tried to create an account with this address.
team.reset: Someone asked to reset the password for this Konnected account.
team.google: Konnected team accounts sign in with Google only, so no link was sent and nothing has changed.
team.ignore: If this was not you, you can ignore this email.

reset.subject: Reset your Konnected password
reset.heading: Choose a new password
reset.body: Someone asked to reset the password for this Konnected account. Use the button within an hour. The link works once.
reset.ignore: If you did not ask for this, ignore this email. Your password has not changed.

methodAdded.subject: A new way to sign in was added
methodAdded.heading: A new way to sign in to Konnected
methodAdded.google: Google is now linked to your Konnected account. From now on you can sign in with Google.
methodAdded.password: A password was set for your Konnected account. From now on you can sign in with your email and this password.
methodAdded.body: Konnected links a way to sign in only when it uses the same verified email address as your account.
methodAdded.notYou: If this was not you, write to the Konnected team right away so we can secure your account.

accountPaused.subject: Your Konnected account is paused
accountPaused.heading: Your account is paused
accountPaused.body: The Konnected team has paused your account. You cannot sign in until the team makes it active again. Nothing has been deleted.
accountPaused.contact: If you think this is a mistake, write to the Konnected team.
accountPaused.ignore: You get this email so you know why you cannot sign in.

accountReactivated.subject: Your Konnected account is active again
accountReactivated.heading: Your account is active again
accountReactivated.body: The Konnected team has made your account active again. You can sign in as before.
accountReactivated.ignore: If you did not expect this, write to the Konnected team.

roleChanged.subject: Your Konnected account type was changed
roleChanged.heading: Your account type was changed
roleChanged.student: The Konnected team changed your account to a student account.
roleChanged.company: The Konnected team changed your account to a company account.
roleChanged.body: The answers you gave for the other account type were removed. Next time you sign in, Konnected asks the questions for your new account type.
roleChanged.ignore: If you did not ask for this, write to the Konnected team.

projectSubmitted.subject: Konnected received your project
projectSubmitted.heading: Your project is with Konnected
projectSubmitted.body: Thank you. Konnected received “{title}” and will review it.
projectSubmitted.review: We review projects within a few working days. Konnected may approve it, ask you for changes, or tell you why it cannot go ahead. Students see nothing until Konnected publishes it.
projectSubmitted.next: You get an email when the review is done. You cannot edit the project while it is in review.
projectSubmitted.ignore: If you did not send this project, write to the Konnected team.

companyApproved.subject: Your company is approved on Konnected
companyApproved.heading: Your company is approved
companyApproved.body: Konnected has approved {name}. You can now send in your first project.
companyApproved.next: Konnected reviews every project before students see it.
companyApproved.ignore: If you did not register this company, write to the Konnected team.

companyRejected.subject: Konnected could not approve {name}
companyRejected.heading: Konnected could not approve your company
companyRejected.body: Konnected looked at {name} and could not approve it. The reason:
companyRejected.resend: If something can be corrected, correct your details in your company profile and send them again. You can do this once.
companyRejected.final: If you think this is a mistake, write to the Konnected team.
companyRejected.ignore: If you did not register this company, write to the Konnected team.

companyInfo.subject: Konnected needs more information about {name}
companyInfo.heading: Konnected needs more information
companyInfo.body: Konnected is reviewing {name} and needs a little more from you:
companyInfo.resend: Correct your details in your company profile and save them. Your company stays in review until then.
companyInfo.ignore: If you did not register this company, write to the Konnected team.

projectChanges.subject: Konnected asks for changes to your project
projectChanges.heading: Changes asked
projectChanges.body: Konnected reviewed “{title}” and asks you to change a few things:
projectChanges.next: Edit the project and send it again. It comes back to Konnected for review.
projectChanges.ignore: If you did not send this project, write to the Konnected team.

projectRejected.subject: Konnected could not approve your project
projectRejected.heading: Your project was not approved
projectRejected.body: Konnected reviewed “{title}” and cannot take it on. The reason:
projectRejected.next: You are welcome to send a new project that fits better.
projectRejected.ignore: If you did not send this project, write to the Konnected team.

projectApproved.subject: Konnected approved your project
projectApproved.heading: Your project is approved
projectApproved.price: The fixed price is {price} excluding VAT ({total} including 25% VAT). Payment terms are 14 days.
projectApproved.next: Konnected publishes it for students next. You get an email when it is published.
projectApproved.ignore: If you did not send this project, write to the Konnected team.

projectPublished.subject: Your project is published on Konnected
projectPublished.heading: Your project is published
projectPublished.next: Konnected picks one student by hand after applications close and tells you who it is.
projectPublished.ignore: If you did not send this project, write to the Konnected team.

profileReviewed.subject: Konnected reviewed your profile
profileReviewed.heading: Your profile is reviewed
profileReviewed.next: Konnected can now select you for a project. Keep your profile up to date.
profileReviewed.ignore: If you do not have a Konnected profile, write to the Konnected team.

profileChanges.subject: Konnected asks you to update your profile
profileChanges.heading: Please update your profile
profileChanges.body: Konnected looked at your profile and asks you to change a few things:
profileChanges.next: Update your profile and save it. It comes back to Konnected for review. You can still browse and apply in the meantime.
profileChanges.ignore: If you do not have a Konnected profile, write to the Konnected team.

applicationReceived.subject: Konnected received your application
applicationReceived.heading: Your application is with Konnected
applicationReceived.body: You applied to “{title}”. Konnected reads every application and picks one student by hand.
applicationReceived.decideBy: Konnected decides by {date}, 3 working days after applications close. You get an email either way.
applicationReceived.decideNoDate: Konnected decides within 3 working days after applications close. You get an email either way.
applicationReceived.profileWaiting: Konnected is still reviewing your profile. It is reviewed before Konnected decides.
applicationReceived.next: You can follow your application, and withdraw it, under My applications. If you withdraw, you cannot apply to this project again.
applicationReceived.ignore: If you did not apply, write to the Konnected team.

selected.subject: You are selected for “{title}”
selected.heading: Konnected selected you
selected.shares: {company} will see only what you agreed to share: your {items}.
selected.sharesNothing: You share nothing with {company} yet. You can choose what to share on your profile.
selected.next: Konnected will contact you to agree what to deliver and by when.
selected.ignore: If you did not apply to this project, write to the Konnected team.

notSelected.subject: An update on “{title}”
notSelected.heading: Konnected picked another student
notSelected.body: Konnected picked another student for “{title}”. Your profile stays active for new projects.
notSelected.ignore: If you did not apply to this project, write to the Konnected team.

found.subject: We found your student for “{title}”
found.heading: We found your student
found.shares: The student agreed to share their {items} with you. You find them on the project page.
found.sharesNothing: The student has not chosen to share any details with you yet. Konnected stays your contact.
found.next: Konnected will contact you to agree the next steps.
found.ignore: If you do not know this project, write to the Konnected team.

released.subject: Your deliverable is ready: “{title}”
released.heading: Konnected released the work to you
released.body: Konnected checked the work on “{title}” and released it to you. You can download it on the project page.
released.bodyFixed: Konnected checked the fixed work on “{title}” and released it to you. You can download it on the project page.
released.accept: Please accept the work, or ask for one round of fixes by {date}. After that it counts as accepted.
released.acceptFixed: This was your one round of fixes, so the work now only needs your acceptance. After 7 days it counts as accepted.
released.ignore: If you do not know this project, write to the Konnected team.

returned.subject: Konnected asked for more: “{title}”
returned.heading: Konnected asked for more
returned.body: Konnected checked what you sent for “{title}” and asks you to add or fix something before the company sees it.
returned.next: Open your application to read what Konnected asks, then send the work again.
returned.ignore: If you are not working on this project, write to the Konnected team.

fixRequested.subject: A fix is asked: “{title}”
fixRequested.heading: {company} asked for a fix
fixRequested.body: {company} asked for a round of fixes on your work on “{title}”.
fixRequested.next: Open your application to read what to fix, then send the fixed work. Konnected checks it before the company sees it again.
fixRequested.ignore: If you are not working on this project, write to the Konnected team.

acceptedStudent.subject: Your work is accepted: “{title}”
acceptedStudent.heading: Your work is accepted
acceptedStudent.body: {company} accepted your work on “{title}”. Well done.
acceptedStudent.bodyAuto: The 7 days for fixes on “{title}” are over, so your work counts as accepted. Well done.
acceptedStudent.paid: Konnected pays you in the monthly pay run after the company has paid.
acceptedStudent.unpaid: This project is unpaid, so there is no payment.
acceptedStudent.ignore: If you are not working on this project, write to the Konnected team.

acceptedCompany.subject: The work is accepted: “{title}”
acceptedCompany.heading: The work is accepted
acceptedCompany.body: The work on “{title}” is accepted. Thank you for working with Konnected.
acceptedCompany.bodyAuto: The 7 days for fixes on “{title}” are over, so the work counts as accepted.
acceptedCompany.paid: Konnected sends the invoice separately. Payment terms are 14 days.
acceptedCompany.unpaid: This project is unpaid, so there is nothing to pay.
acceptedCompany.ignore: If you do not know this project, write to the Konnected team.

received.subject: Konnected has your message about “{title}”
received.heading: We have your message
received.body: Konnected got your message about “{title}” for {company}. The team answers within 2 working days and agrees the next step with you.
received.next: {company} is told the new plan, never your note. Keep working on what you can until Konnected answers.
received.ignore: If you did not send this, write to the Konnected team.

dueDateStudent.subject: New due date for “{title}”
dueDateStudent.heading: Your due date moved
dueDateStudent.body: Konnected moved the due date for “{title}” from {from} to {date}.
dueDateStudent.next: Upload your work in the app when it is ready. Konnected checks it before {company} sees it.
dueDateStudent.ignore: If you are not working on this project, write to the Konnected team.
dueDateStudent.bodySet: Konnected set the due date for “{title}”: {date}.

dueDateCompany.subject: New due date for “{title}”
dueDateCompany.heading: The due date moved
dueDateCompany.body: The student needs more time, and Konnected agreed a new due date for “{title}”: {date} (it was {from}).
dueDateCompany.next: Konnected still checks the work before it is released to you.
dueDateCompany.ignore: If this is not your project, write to the Konnected team.
dueDateCompany.bodySet: The student needed more time, and Konnected agreed the due date for “{title}”: {date}.

endedStudent.subject: Your work on “{title}” has ended
endedStudent.heading: Konnected ended the match
endedStudent.body: Konnected ended your work on “{title}” for {company}, as agreed with you. The project looks for another student.
endedStudent.next: Files you uploaded stay with Konnected; nothing is released to {company}. You can apply to other projects.
endedStudent.ignore: If you have questions, write to the Konnected team.

closedStudent.subject: “{title}” is closed
closedStudent.heading: The project is closed
closedStudent.body: Konnected closed “{title}” for {company} without delivery. Konnected's reason:
closedStudent.next: Files you uploaded stay with Konnected; nothing is released to {company}. Konnected tells you about any payment.
closedStudent.ignore: If you have questions, write to the Konnected team.

rematchCompany.subject: “{title}”: Konnected is finding a new student
rematchCompany.heading: Konnected is finding a new student
rematchCompany.body: The student could not continue with “{title}”, so Konnected ended the match and opened the project for applications again until {date}.
rematchCompany.next: Nothing from the first student was released to you. You see the new student once Konnected selects one.
rematchCompany.ignore: If this is not your project, write to the Konnected team.

closedNoDeliveryCompany.subject: “{title}” is closed without delivery
closedNoDeliveryCompany.heading: The project is closed
closedNoDeliveryCompany.body: Konnected closed “{title}” without delivery. Konnected's reason:
closedNoDeliveryCompany.next: Nothing unfinished was released to you. Konnected decides payment case by case and tells you if anything is owed.
closedNoDeliveryCompany.ignore: If this is not your project, write to the Konnected team.

closedNoMatchCompany.subject: “{title}” is closed without a match
closedNoMatchCompany.heading: The project is closed
closedNoMatchCompany.body: Konnected closed “{title}” without selecting a student. Konnected's reason:
closedNoMatchCompany.next: You can submit a new project at any time.
closedNoMatchCompany.ignore: If this is not your project, write to the Konnected team.

reopenedCompany.subject: Applications reopened for “{title}”
reopenedCompany.heading: Applications are open again
reopenedCompany.body: No student was selected for “{title}” yet, so Konnected opened the project for applications again until {date}.
reopenedCompany.next: Konnected picks one student by hand and tells you.
reopenedCompany.ignore: If this is not your project, write to the Konnected team.

teamMorning.subject: Good morning, {name}: {count} for you today
teamMorning.heading: Good morning, {name}
teamMorning.intro: Here is what is yours on Konnected today.
teamMorning.pool: {count} waiting in the shared pool. The oldest has waited {days} working days.
teamMorning.ignore: You get this email on working days when something of yours is due today or overdue.

teamProblem.subject: Problem reported: “{title}”
teamProblem.heading: A student reported a problem
teamProblem.next: Open the project to read the report and choose what happens next. Konnected answers within 2 working days.
teamProblem.pool: Nobody on the team owns this company, so the whole team gets this email. Take it from the shared pool if it is yours.
teamProblem.ignore: You get this email because you are on the Konnected team.

invoiceSent.subject: Invoice sent for “{title}”
invoiceSent.heading: Your invoice is on its way
invoiceSent.body: Konnected has sent the invoice for “{title}”: {price} excluding VAT, {total} including 25 % VAT.
invoiceSent.bodyNoAmount: Konnected has sent the invoice for “{title}”.
invoiceSent.due: Payment terms are 14 days: please pay by {date}.
invoiceSent.next: You find the invoice and its status under Payments.
invoiceSent.ignore: If you do not know this project, write to the Konnected team.

invoicePaid.subject: Payment received for “{title}”
invoicePaid.heading: Thank you, we have your payment
invoicePaid.body: Konnected has received your payment of {total} for “{title}”.
invoicePaid.bodyNoAmount: Konnected has received your payment for “{title}”.
invoicePaid.next: You find the invoice and its status under Payments.
invoicePaid.ignore: If you do not know this project, write to the Konnected team.

studentPaid.subject: You have been paid for “{title}”
studentPaid.heading: Your pay is on its way
studentPaid.body: Konnected has paid you {amount} for “{title}” in this month’s pay run.
studentPaid.bodyNoAmount: Konnected has paid you for “{title}” in this month’s pay run.
studentPaid.next: It can take a few days before it shows in your bank account. You find the details under Payments.
studentPaid.ignore: If you did not work on this project, write to the Konnected team.

DesignGuide.title: Design base

DesignGuide.typeSecondary: Secondary text for labels, hints and dates.
DesignGuide.emailHint: We send updates about your projects here.
DesignGuide.agree: I agree to share my CV with the startup after Konnected selects me
DesignGuide.cardBody: Write the text for a new landing page. About 20 hours over 2 weeks.
DesignGuide.dialogBody: You cannot apply to this project again after you withdraw.

toSign.subject: An agreement is ready for you to sign
toSign.heading: Your agreement with Konnected is ready
toSign.company: Konnected approved {title}. The project is published once you and Konnected have signed the agreement.
toSign.student: Konnected made your agreement for {title}. The work starts once you and Konnected have signed it.
toSign.how: Open it in Konnected, read the PDF, tick the box and type your full name to sign.
toSign.ignore: If you did not expect this, contact Konnected before you sign.

signed.subject: Signed agreement {reference}
signed.heading: The agreement is signed
signed.body: Both parties have signed the agreement for {title} ({reference}).
signed.attached: The signed PDF is attached. Keep it with your records.
signed.ignore: If something in the agreement is wrong, contact Konnected. A signed agreement is never changed; Konnected makes a new one.

AgreementFields.agreement_date: The date the agreement is made
AgreementFields.agreement_reference: The agreement's reference, for example AGR-3F9A61C0

AgreementSign.title: Your agreement with Konnected
AgreementSign.afterCompany: The project is published once you and Konnected have signed.
AgreementSign.afterStudent: The work starts once you and Konnected have signed.
AgreementSign.emailNote: When both have signed, Konnected emails the signed PDF to you automatically.
AgreementSign.waitingBody: Konnected signs next, usually the same day. Then the signed PDF is emailed to you.
AgreementSign.signedBody: The signed PDF was emailed to you on {date}.

AgreementSign.agree: I have read the agreement and agree to it

AgreementSign.listLede: Your agreements with Konnected. Open one to read and sign it.
AgreementSign.listEmpty: No agreements yet. Konnected makes one when it is time to sign.

errors.not_your_turn: It is not your turn to sign this agreement.
errors.not_ticked: Tick the box to say you have read the agreement.
errors.authority_not_ticked: Tick the box to confirm you may sign for the company.
errors.document_changed: The agreement changed after you opened it. Reload the page and read it again.

TeamAgreements.title: Agreements
TeamAgreements.lede: Konnected fills its own templates from each project: one agreement with the company before the project is published, and one with the student before the work starts. Both sign in the app, then Konnected signs last, and the signed PDF is emailed to both.
TeamAgreements.toMakeBody: Approved projects need a company agreement before they are published. Matched projects need a student agreement before the work starts.
TeamAgreements.madeToast: The agreement is being made. The PDF is ready in a few seconds.
TeamAgreements.waitingTitle: Waiting for the company or the student
TeamAgreements.waitingEmpty: Nothing waits for the other party.
TeamAgreements.noPublished: No published template. Agreements of this kind cannot be made yet.
TeamAgreements.signKonnectedBody: The {party} signed on {date}. Sign for Konnected to finish it. The signed PDF is then emailed to both automatically.
TeamAgreements.withdrawBody: The parties can no longer sign this version. It stays in the records, marked withdrawn.
TeamAgreements.withdrawAndRemake: Withdraw and make a new one
TeamAgreements.remadeToast: Withdrawn. A new version is being made.
TeamAgreements.emailPending: The email to both is on its way

failure.template: The template could not be filled. Check the template and make the agreement again.
failure.converter: The PDF converter did not answer. Make the agreement again in a moment.
failure.missing_value: The field {field} has no value. Fill it in on the project, then make the agreement again.

errors.forbidden: Only the Konnected team can do this.
errors.wrong_status: The project is not at the right step for this.
errors.no_template: There is no published template for this agreement. Publish one first.
errors.missing_values: These fields have no value yet: {fields}. Fill them in on the project first.
errors.already_exists: This project already has an agreement in use. Withdraw it first to make a new one.

AgreementTemplates.title: Agreement templates
AgreementTemplates.lede: Your legal text, written by Konnected. Every new agreement is made from the published version of its template; agreements already made keep the version they were made from.
AgreementTemplates.uploadBody: The new version is saved as a draft. Publish it to use it for new agreements.
AgreementTemplates.fileHint: A .docx file with fields like {example}. Up to {max} MB.
AgreementTemplates.publishedToast: Published. New agreements use this version.
AgreementTemplates.fieldsBody: Write the legal text in Word and put a field where a value from the project should go, with double braces as shown. Konnected fills them in and makes a PDF for each agreement. Any other field is refused at upload.
AgreementTemplates.notAllowed: That did not work. Reload the page and try again.

problems.kind: Choose which agreement this template is for.
problems.not_docx: This is not a Word (.docx) file.

problems.unzipped_too_large: The Word file is too large inside. Remove large images and try again.
problems.too_many_parts: The Word file has too many parts. Save it again as a plain document.
problems.broken_file: The Word file could not be read. Save it again as a .docx file.

problems.unknown_fields: These fields are not ones Konnected knows: {tags}. Remove them or use a field from the list.
problems.not_allowed_here: These fields cannot be used in this agreement: {tags}

problems.no_fields: The file has no fields. Add at least one, such as the project title.
